title: Build and validate the hourglass icon candidate
outcome: Freeze WellSpent 0.2.0 (6) with adaptive hourglass icons, run full clean-source CI, and independently inspect its signed Release archive.

included: Allocate build 6 without reusing build 5, preserving version 0.2.0 and all product identities.
Regenerate the project, freeze exact source and run full CI on the new candidate.
Create and independently inspect a new signed Release archive with the new icon variants.
Record coordinator-managed task and evidence integration.
excluded: Product behavior changes, model/wire migrations and signing-identity changes.
App Store upload, distribution export, submission, public release and tester invitations.
Device mutation, which is a separate task after packaging.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A clean exact-source receipt identifies 0.2.0 (6), with no changes beyond version allocation, generated-project parity and documentation after icon review.
Full thirteen-stage CI passes on the frozen 0.2.0 (6) source.
The signed archive passes four-component inspection and contains the new light/dark iPhone icon and matching Watch icon.
